refs.title: Battery drain / dead battery (2019–2021 Forester)
refs.text: Common causes: power rear gate module (hatch left open ~4 A), DCM/STARLINK not sleeping, short-trip driving. Fixes: latest PRG/DCM TSBs at the dealer, smart battery maintainer, and the battery-drain class settlement (2015–2020 Forester) for extended battery warranty. Battery type Q-85 (EFB, start-stop).

refs.title: CVT judder / slipping / failure
refs.text: 2019–20 Forester 2.5L CVT warranty extended to 10 yr / 100k mi (TSB 16-155-25R). Get a free dealer inspection. Use only Subaru CVTF-II. Many owners drain/fill around 60k despite the 'lifetime' fluid claim. Total capacity about 12.7 US qt.

refs.title: Thermo Control Valve (TCV): P2682 / P26A**, EyeSight off, no heat
refs.text: Coolant thermo control valve failure. Covered 15 yr / 150k mi on 2019–21 Forester (TSB 09-119-24). The dealer replaces the TCV, and you can get reimbursed if you already paid.

refs.title: EyeSight disabled / 'EyeSight Off'
refs.text: Check for TCV codes first (above), then a dirty, fogged, or iced windshield in front of the cameras, or heavy rain, snow, or sun glare (temporary). Cracks in the camera area can't be repaired. Use genuine Subaru glass and require camera calibration after windshield replacement.

refs.title: Oil consumption (FB25 DI)
refs.text: The 2019+ engine isn't part of the older 2011–14 oil-burning problem. Check the dipstick every other fill-up. Use 0W-20 synthetic, 4.4 US qt with filter. Low to full = 1.1 qt. If it uses more than about 1 qt per 1,200 mi, have the dealer run an oil consumption test.

refs.title: Forester 2020 helpful notes
refs.text: 2020 Forester, 2.5L FB25 boxer (direct injection), Lineartronic CVT. CVT fluid: Subaru CVTF-II (blue/green), NOT the orange high-torque CVTF. Severe service often calls for earlier CVT drain/fill (many do 30–60k). Common complaints: low-speed CVT judder, valve body/solenoid issues, occasional early CVT failure (document it and check warranty). EyeSight/STARLINK supplements are separate booklets. Full service manuals are only on paid STIS (techinfo.subaru.com).
